title: Double Jump Boots
description: This mod adds boots that can give you double jump!
body: This mod adds double jump boots to the game! (using jump boost potions is OP) this can help with PvP, jumping, building etc. people always wanted to have this, I made this an item not an effect! (Bug: there is a bug if you have it in your inventory without wearing then the effect applies! this is unintended, I'm trying to code something to stop the bug, if someone can code a bugfix then please do! I'm new to modding!)
